question: Does the physical directed-midpoint measure admit a size-uniform charge-fiber sector-balance mechanism, or can canonical charge fibers be proved to develop unbounded logical-sector imbalance?
claim_boundary: Crossing probability and NMP are insufficient. This contract must act on physical charge-fiber multiplicities or an equivalent charge-preserving switching congestion; it may not infer balance from support alone.
alternatives: Construct a charge-preserving switching or fractional transport with size-uniform congestion on a positive-probability physical event.
Prove boundary-flux anti-concentration or conditional-entropy control that directly lower-bounds the physical average minority ratio.
Construct a canonical square charge-fiber family with provably unbounded sector imbalance, rejecting every-record uniform balance and isolating the weaker averaged theorem still needed.
planned_steps: Review primary orientation, flow, and conditional-entropy results only for hypotheses that preserve the measured charge fibers and logical parity split.
Formalize and test the smallest symbolic constructions for all three branches; use L3/L4 tables only as exact controls and do not extrapolate them.
State whether the result is a uniform physical theorem, a counterexample to per-record balance, or an explicit missing averaged lemma.
Stop without midpoint noncorrectability or a threshold claim unless a positive size-uniform physical average bound is proved.
stop_rule: Stop at a proved physical balance/congestion theorem, a canonical analytic imbalance family, or an explicit missing averaged-lemma boundary after primary-source review. Do not enumerate L5, fit finite-size trends, or identify p=1/2 as a threshold.
